title: French Bulldog Lifespan: What the Studies Show and How to Help
seoTitle: French Bulldog Lifespan: How Long Do Frenchies Live?
description: French Bulldog lifespan from the largest studies: the 9.8-year median, where the 4.5-year figure comes from, common causes of death and how to help.
secondaryKeywords: how long do french bulldogs live
french bulldog lifespan male vs female

faq.q: How long do French Bulldogs live on average?
faq.a: A 2024 UK study of 584,734 dogs found a median lifespan of 9.8 years for French Bulldogs, compared with 12.5 years for all dogs. Many individual Frenchies live longer or shorter than that.

faq.q: Do French Bulldogs really only live 4.5 years?
faq.a: No. The 4.5-year figure comes from a 2022 life-table study whose authors warned that its French Bulldog sample was small and skewed toward young dogs. The larger 2024 study gives a median of 9.8 years.

faq.q: Do male or female French Bulldogs live longer?
faq.a: In the UK VetCompass study of French Bulldogs, longevity did not differ between males and females.

faq.q: What do French Bulldogs usually die from?
faq.a: In a UK study of French Bulldog deaths, brain disorders and spinal cord disorders were the most common recorded causes, followed by respiratory problems, tumors, behavior problems and injuries.

faq.q: How can I help my French Bulldog live longer?
faq.a: Keep your dog lean, get breathing problems checked, prevent heatstroke, protect the spine and keep up with regular vet checkups.
